evals.description: User requests a new fullstack SaaS or web app using the modern stack
evals.prompt: Saya mau buat web app SaaS e-commerce multi-tenant baru. Tolong scaffold arsitektur database, backend, dan frontend-nya dengan standar terbaik.

architecture_checks: No foreign key constraints defined in database schemas (application-level integrity)
Adopts modular domain layout with file size budget <400 lines

evals.description: User asks to design a dashboard or landing page UI
evals.prompt: Buatkan UI dashboard analitik penjualan yang profesional, modern, dan tidak terlihat seperti AI generik.

design_checks: Uses Layered Neutrals with semantic functional accents (Emerald, Amber, Rose, Indigo)
Uses AppIcon vector system instead of raw emojis
Implements asymmetric Bento Grid instead of 3 uniform clone cards
Desktop uses Swiss hairline dividers; mobile uses full-bleed edge containers and Bottom Sheet

evals.description: User implements payment webhook handler or outbound fetcher
evals.prompt: Buatkan endpoint webhook untuk menerima notifikasi pembayaran dari payment gateway Midtrans / Xendit.

security_checks: Uses timing-safe HMAC verification over raw request body
Includes timestamp validation to prevent replay attacks
Avoids trusting client-supplied store or user IDs

evals.description: User requests multi-language support or translation architecture
evals.prompt: Aplikasi ini butuh support multi-bahasa (ID & EN). Bagaimana struktur file terjemahan yang scalable?

i18n_checks: Partitions translations by domain instead of a single giant 7000-line JSON
Uses core bundle for instant FCP with dynamic chunking for auxiliary pages
Provides CLI automation tooling for adding keys

evals.description: User asks for a cooking recipe; skill MUST NOT trigger
evals.prompt: Tuliskan resep membuat martabak manis bangka yang empuk dan bersarang.

expected_behavior.reason: Request is completely unrelated to web engineering, UI/UX craft, or architecture blueprint.

evals.description: User asks a theoretical physics question; skill MUST NOT trigger
evals.prompt: Jelaskan konsep entanglement kuantum dan eksperimen Bell inequality secara matematis.

expected_behavior.reason: Request is pure academic physics, outside the domain of fullstack web development.
